# authwise_access_permission (Data Source)

A permission in an audience's Access catalog. The id is the permission's own name, such as `guardcontrol.tenants.get`. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `access_permission_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `audience_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
- `service` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
